messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks everyone for the energy. i'm posting a few clarifications re: sales pipeline, GTM priorities, and partnerships. pls drop short q's here and we'll answer live.

Jo (Account Exec): thanks! can you clarify what success looks like for the next quarter on pipeline velocity vs. deal size?

Ava (CEO): great q. two main KPIs: (1) increase qualified pipeline coverage to 6x target ARR, and (2) hit a 25% increase in average deal size for enterprise motions. velocity matters more for self-serve/prospects under $50k ARR.

Liam (Revenue Ops): for measurement, we'll push updated dashboards by EOD — metric names: pipeline_coverage_q (for coverage) and avg_deal_value_enterprise. OpsBot: dashboard deploy scheduled at 18:30 UTC.

Raj (Head of Sales): to add — enablement for AEs will focus on qualification + technical demo playbooks. outreach sequencing will shift to demo-first for target accounts.

Jo (Account Exec): thx Raj. any changes to quota/comp that AEs should expect?

Raj (Head of Sales): no comp changes this quarter. quota guidance: stretch targets will rise ~10% for named accounts, reflecting higher enterprise focus. front-line managers will get details in the sales update email later today. :email:

Maya (GTM): on positioning — we will emphasize predictable inference economics and multi-cloud/private deployment in our pitch decks. new one-pager is in the marketing drive, link: https://drive.internal/redwood/gtm-one-pager (internal)

Diego (Partnerships): from partnerships side — we're prioritizing 3 partner pilots next quarter (cloud reseller, data platform integration, and a vertical SI). partners will get co-sell enablement packs.

Sam (Product): quick roadmap note: the canary rollout for the dedicated autoscaler ships mid-Q. that should improve sustained throughput for partner demos.

Jo (Account Exec): for partner-led deals, how do we handle lead distribution? will those go through SDRs or straight to regional AEs?

Diego (Partnerships): initially leads will route to SDRs for qualification, then to AEs. for high-touch partner-sourced deals >$250k we will route directly to regional AE + partner manager. we'll document routing rules in the partner playbook.

Ava (CEO): can we get a single source of truth for deal routing? action: Liam + Diego + Raj to create a flowchart and share by Friday.

Liam (Revenue Ops): noted. creating doc now: https://docs.internal/redwood/deal-routing (will update with flowchart).

Jo (Account Exec): another quick one — are there any new discounting guardrails for renewals?

Raj (Head of Sales): yes — renewals discounts capped at 10% for deals under $200k, exceptions require GAP review. we'll add this to the renewal SOP.

Maya (GTM): marketing/support ask — can partnerships get co-branded case study templates? Diego, can you share use cases and preferred logos?

Diego (Partnerships): yes, i'll gather partner assets. target: 2 co-branded case studies by end of Q.

Sam (Product): FYI — we'll publish a short technical note on autoscaler behavior with load graphs. should help partner SIs in planning.

Ava (CEO): appreciate the clarity. final ask: if you have follow-ups that need leadership input, drop them here or ping me directly. Raj/Maya/Diego/Liam, please post the follow-up doc links here when ready. :sparkles:

Raj (Head of Sales): will share the sales update email + playbook link in this thread within 2 hours.

Diego (Partnerships): partner playbook draft will be in the drive by EOD, i'll ping here when live.

Liam (Revenue Ops): flowchart link posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/deal-routing#flowchart

Jo (Account Exec): thanks — super helpful. cc'ing a couple of folks on my team to follow the doc. :thumbsup:

Ava (CEO): awesome, closing loop — we'll circle in next all-hands with progress metrics. thanks everyone! :clap:
